comprehension.opening_rationale: Beat B010 visually establishes the physical setting and dynamic immediately: a royal sentry in white gloves halting a cart driver claiming to deliver firewood at a security checkpoint.
comprehension.arc_rationale: The narrative arc is entirely self-contained: infiltrators posing as cart drivers ambush the guards to breach the sanctuary and report to their unseen leader ('the Duke').
comprehension.situational_summary: Infiltrators masquerading as cart drivers ambush royal cathedral guards to clear the road for their Duke.

emotional_salience.emotional_core: Surprise tactical ambush and calculated insurgent breach

spoiler.spoiler_rationale: Shows the infiltration/attack inciting incident that breaches the cathedral perimeter.

comprehension.opening_rationale: Beat B019 opens with a grand cinematic visual reveal: barn doors parting onto a snow-covered landscape as a regal figure in ducal attire steps into the light.
comprehension.arc_rationale: Clear self-contained motivation and status: an exiled noble commands his loyalists to secure a chapel as he marches to reclaim his stolen house.
comprehension.situational_summary: An exiled duke emerges in full splendor and commands his men to secure a chapel as he marches to reclaim his stolen house.

emotional_salience.emotional_core: Righteous aristocratic defiance and resolute reclamation of power

spoiler.spoiler_rationale: Reveals the protagonist's identity, ducal status, and decision to end his exile.

comprehension.opening_rationale: Beat B019 delivers an unmistakable visual anchor: barn doors opening outward onto snow as Alexander emerges in ducal splendor.
comprehension.arc_rationale: Completely grounded personal and narrative arc: Alexander reclaims his title and marches to rescue his imperiled wife from the chapel.
comprehension.situational_summary: A returned duke emerges from hiding to secure a chapel, reclaim his house, and rescue his wife.

emotional_salience.emotional_core: Fierce vengeance paired with desperate protective romantic urgency

spoiler.spoiler_rationale: Establishes the core stakes of the protagonist's mission to rescue his wife and reclaim his birthright.

comprehension.opening_rationale: Beat B021 opens abruptly mid-interaction with a soldier kneeling in the snow addressing an unseen figure with 'Your Grace' without visual establishment of the leader, setting, or context.
comprehension.arc_rationale: The full arc clarifies Alexander's mission to take back his house and save his wife, but this requires downstream dialogue to contextualize.
comprehension.situational_summary: A soldier kneels before a duke who orders a chapel secured so he can reclaim his house and rescue his wife.

emotional_salience.emotional_core: Resolute reclamation and vows of rescue

spoiler.spoiler_rationale: Discloses Alexander's return and his personal quest to save his wife.

comprehension.opening_rationale: Beat B022 immediately establishes Alexander in close-up profile amidst winter cold delivering an authoritative command ('Secure the chapel'). The physical winter atmosphere and commanding dynamic are grounded in the first 2 seconds.
comprehension.arc_rationale: The conflict and motivation are completely self-contained: a returning nobleman/leader ('Your Grace') orders an assault, vows to reclaim his house, and sets out to rescue his wife from the chapel.
comprehension.situational_summary: A determined commander marches through the winter cold toward a distant chapel, ordering his men to secure it as he vows to reclaim his stolen house and rescue his wife.

emotional_salience.emotional_core: Fierce, unyielding vengeance and protective determination

spoiler.spoiler_rationale: Reveals the turning point/inciting march where the protagonist drops hiding and initiates an armed rescue of his wife and reclamation of his house.
